productConcept.name: IRID Structural Color Systems
productConcept.description: Advanced biomimetic thin-film coatings that produce iridescent structural color through light interference rather than pigment, inspired by morpho butterfly wing physics.
productConcept.rationale: The holographic/iridescent aesthetic maps directly to a material science company producing structural color coatings — the hue-rotate interactions simulate angle-dependent spectral shift of real foil, and the Syncopate + dark teal palette evokes precision instrumentation.

animationDecision: motion-tokens — holographic keyframes (holoShift 8s, shimmerSweep, rainbowShift 4s, prismaticReveal, chromaFlicker 3s) with named prism/foil/shimmer easings
